company.name: Mantas
company.shortDescription: Mantas tackles the critical issue of cloud downtime for businesses by providing parametric insurance coverage and predictive analytics
company.description:
Cloud outage is one of the most predictable risks facing businesses today, and one of the most underinsured.

Mantas is an insurtech that designs parametric insurance for cloud-first businesses. Pre-defined triggers, real-time monitoring, and swift payouts without delays.

productsAndServices.description: Parametric insurance for financial losses caused by qualifying public cloud service outages, using predefined triggers, real-time verification, and automatic payouts.
productsAndServices.name: Cloud Outage Insurance

productsAndServices.description: Modular insurance coverage for cyber risks, including data exposure, cyberattacks, and privacy-related incidents, supported by prevention and incident-response services.
productsAndServices.name: Cyber Insurance
